style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a weathered concrete plant floor, wide asymmetrical framing with generous negative space. An unlatched inspection gate mechanism in brushed steel and graphite, allowing a visibly flawed, jagged polymer module to pass through a glowing green sensor ring. One strong directional light throwing a long cast shadow from the left, matte muted palette of graphite, weathered orange, and safety yellow, hard clean edges, no lettering or text.
negative_prompt: text, letters, typography, watermark, signature, garbled text, random lettering
rationale: A component assembly perfectly visualizes the 'strict gate' versus 'formality' concept, showing a physical inspection checkpoint that is failing to stop a defective module.
cue: gate reporting a number it never earned
subject: a modular mechanical inspection gate passing a flawed component
core_thesis: Test suites for AI coding agents are granting passes to defective code, functioning as a mere formality rather than a strict gate.
core_conflict: Appearance of success (green pass rate) versus actual code functionality (undetected defects).
composition: wide asymmetrical framing with generous negative space
